how: Members repeatedly called helpers to paint an Esperanto flag and supplied locations for the shared work.

statement: Relaying decisions between Reddit and an existing chat
how: Plans, agreements and failed negotiations returned through intermediaries while helpers were also directed back into the Reddit thread.

how: The project sought visitors for language promotion, preserving a redirect when spatial pressure required shortening the name.

statement: distinguishing intended visibility from demonstrated recruitment
